sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: To say “they” (*ők*), add *-nak* or *-nek* to the stem. One person, *ő*, has no ending at all: *Anna olvas.* Several people take the ending: *Ők olvasnak.* A stem with a back vowel takes *-nak*, a stem with a front vowel (*e, é, ö, ő, ü, ű*) takes *-nek*.

items.english: In the afternoon they do sport.
They are the ones who study.

sections.content: You know *ők* (“they”) from the family words. Like *én* and *mi*, it is usually left out, because *-nak/-nek* already says “they”. *Ír* is neutral again: *írnak*.
